falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes at least 4.0% below its close on the verdict date on any session within 14 days, and VIX closes above 28 on that same session.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A disorderly break lower with a volatility spike falsifies both HOLD and the bottom_2024_aug analog; the correct call would have been risk-off, not unknown/flat.

falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 50 bps or more versus the verdict-date close, and the US 10-year yield rises by 30 bps or more over the same 14-day window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A simultaneous credit and rates shock did not confirm the Aug 2024 bottom template; pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated and UNKNOWN/HOLD missed a regime break.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 65 on any day in the next 14 days while SPX is up at least 3.0% from the verdict-date close and VIX closes below 14.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A low-vol melt-up with an elevated blowoff score contradicts a bottom setup (score 38, 77% bottom match); the verdict should have resolved to late-cycle blowoff, not UNKNOWN/HOLD.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
